purpose: Document Saharsa's official Bihar cadastral entry points, inspect the current public BhuNaksha JavaScript/configuration and bounded anonymous REST responses, and separate registry evidence from geometry/runtime qualification.
assessment: Saharsa district and Bihar state first-party pages establish an official local revenue/cadastral custodian and link to BhuNaksha. The current public viewer successfully returned Saharsa location selections, a native EPSG:32645 sheet extent, and a bounded anonymous safe plot identifier. It did not return a full parcel polygon in the inspected responses, so no GeoJSON sample is retained and runtime readiness remains held.
registryAssessment: Official local Saharsa district revenue pages plus Bihar's Revenue and Land Reforms / Directorate of Land Records & Survey pages support registryFound=true for official local/state cadastral service custody. This does not establish title, ownership, citywide coverage, or a public vector download.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official Saharsa district and Bihar cadastral/revenue links, live public BhuNaksha selection metadata, one Saharsa mauza sheet extent, and one bounded safe ID response.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: One public cadastral sheet extent and one safe parcel identifier; full polygon geometry and citywide coverage are unverified.

searchQueries.query: Saharsa Bihar official cadastral map Bhu Naksha land records GIS
सहरसा बिहार भू नक्शा भूलेख आधिकारिक भूमि रिकॉर्ड

attempts: Opened the official Saharsa English revenue page; it links to Bihar land records, online mutation, and revenue services.
Opened the official Saharsa Hindi land-record page; it directs users to Bihar land records and identifies the location as Saharsa, Bihar.
Opened the official Bihar Revenue and Land Reforms page; it links Bhu-Naksha and the Directorate of Land Records & Survey.
Opened the Directorate of Land Records & Survey services page; it lists Online Map, Online Revenue Records, and special-survey map services.

Fetched the current public BhuNaksha HTML and index.js over TLS. The JavaScript names rest/Levels/count, rest/Levels/ListsAfterLevel, rest/MapInfo/getVVVVExtentGeoref, rest/MapInfo/getPlotAtXY, ScalarDatahandler, and WMS layers VILLAGE_MAP/PLOT_LIST.
POSTed state=10 to rest/Levels/count; response was 7.

POSTed bounded location-list requests; Saharsa district code 12, subdivision 01, Kahara circle 01, and Saharsa mauza 0019 were present with hasData=true. Cadastral Survey, CS Map, and sheet 01 were selected from public options.
POSTed getPlotAtXY at a bounded point inside that native projected extent; response returned only safe id 7fQdC8zLSpuBMkiYlc8ZiQ and public plot number 311.
GET ScalarDatahandler OP=4 for the same bounded local point; response returned has_data=Y, plotNo=311, the same safe ID, and plot extent metadata, but no polygon geometry.

Did not submit the WUP latitude/longitude to the local projected-coordinate endpoint, did not shift the WUP point, did not request owner/address/title/account/tax fields, did not log in, and did not bypass any CAPTCHA/Cloudflare or TLS verification.
No sample GeoJSON was created because no full parcel polygon response was verified.

geometryEvidence.exactWupPointTest: Not run against local projected parcel coordinates; exact WUP point [25.8750955951988,86.5896244596482] preserved unchanged.
geometryEvidence.polygonResponse: None; WMS was identified as raster rendering and REST probes returned metadata/ID only.

nextStep: Independent serial review of the public service's geometry-export capability and coverage; keep adapter/runtime held until a real safe native polygon response is independently qualified.
remainingUncertainty: The selected cadastral sheet is evidence of a local map service, not citywide coverage. It is unknown whether other sheets cover the urban point or whether an approved public vector/polygon endpoint exists behind the viewer.
